panels.title: ◈ Machine Capability Ranking

targets.rawSql:
WITH pe_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, d.pe_setting, p.pe
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND d.process IN (${process:sqlstring})
    AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND d.fpn IN (${fpn:sqlstring})
    AND d.layer_name IN (${layer:sqlstring})
    AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND p.pe IS NOT NULL AND d.pe_setting IS NOT NULL
),
pe_stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, COUNT(*) AS n_pe, AVG(pe) AS mean_pe, STDDEV_SAMP(pe) AS stddev_pe, AVG(pe_setting) AS pe_limit
  FROM pe_samples GROUP BY eqp_id
),
pe_capability AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, n_pe,
    pe_limit / NULLIF(3 * stddev_pe, 0) AS cp_pe,
    LEAST((pe_limit - mean_pe) / NULLIF(3 * stddev_pe, 0), (mean_pe + pe_limit) / NULLIF(3 * stddev_pe, 0)) AS cpk_pe
  FROM pe_stats
),
je_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, d.je_setting, j.je
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.je_1),(d.je_2),(d.je_3),(d.je_4)) j(je)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND d.process IN (${process:sqlstring})
    AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND d.fpn IN (${fpn:sqlstring})
    AND d.layer_name IN (${layer:sqlstring})
    AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND j.je IS NOT NULL AND d.je_setting IS NOT NULL
),
je_stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, COUNT(*) AS n_je, AVG(je) AS mean_je, STDDEV_SAMP(je) AS stddev_je, AVG(je_setting) AS je_limit
  FROM je_samples GROUP BY eqp_id
),
je_capability AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, n_je,
    je_limit / NULLIF(3 * stddev_je, 0) AS cp_je,
    LEAST((je_limit - mean_je) / NULLIF(3 * stddev_je, 0), (mean_je + je_limit) / NULLIF(3 * stddev_je, 0)) AS cpk_je
  FROM je_stats
),
combined AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(p.eqp_id, j.eqp_id) AS eqp_id, p.n_pe, p.cp_pe, p.cpk_pe, j.n_je, j.cp_je, j.cpk_je
  FROM pe_capability p FULL OUTER JOIN je_capability j ON p.eqp_id = j.eqp_id
),
worst AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN cpk_pe IS NULL THEN cpk_je WHEN cpk_je IS NULL THEN cpk_pe ELSE LEAST(cpk_pe, cpk_je) END AS worst_cpk,
    CASE WHEN cpk_pe IS NULL THEN n_je WHEN cpk_je IS NULL THEN n_pe WHEN cpk_pe <= cpk_je THEN n_pe ELSE n_je END AS worst_n
  FROM combined
)
SELECT eqp_id AS "Machine",
       n_pe AS "PE Samples", ROUND(cpk_pe::NUMERIC, 3) AS "Cpk (PE)",
       n_je AS "JE Samples", ROUND(cpk_je::NUMERIC, 3) AS "Cpk (JE)",
       ROUND(worst_cpk::NUMERIC, 3) AS "Worst Cpk",
       worst_n AS "N (Worst)",
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(worst_n, 0) < 30 THEN 'LOW SAMPLE (n<30)' ELSE 'OK' END AS "Confidence"
FROM worst
ORDER BY worst_cpk ASC NULLS LAST;

panels.description: Ranked worst-first by Worst Cpk = LEAST(Cpk PE, Cpk JE) — a machine capable on PE but failing JE (or vice versa) is still a failing machine. Colored red (<1.33 Not Capable), amber (1.33–1.67 Capable/Excellent boundary), green (≥1.67 Excellent+). Confidence flags machines where the worse of the two metrics is backed by fewer than 30 samples in the selected window — not yet statistically reliable. Calculated from real PE1-PE6/JE1-JE4 samples in the selected time, Factory, MO and Machine filters. Assumes symmetric +/- setting limits.

targets.rawSql:
WITH pe_samples AS (

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: full dataset scope */
WITH alarm_ctx AS (
  SELECT * FROM v_ldi_alarm_context
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE temperature < 20 OR temperature > 24 OR humidity < 50 OR humidity > 60) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS temp_pct,
    ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE air_vacuum > -50 OR air_vacuum < -95) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS vac_pct,
    ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(pe_1) > 10 OR ABS(je_1) > 10) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS pe_pct
  FROM public.ldi_data
),
cats AS (
  SELECT 'THERMAL (81501)' AS cat, ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag_temp_out_of_spec) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS alarm_pct, COUNT(*) AS n FROM alarm_ctx WHERE errorcode = '81501'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'VACUUM (81101/02)', ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag_vac_out_of_spec) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1), COUNT(*) FROM alarm_ctx WHERE errorcode IN ('81101','81102')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ALIGNMENT (812xx)', ROUND((100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag_pe_out_of_spec) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1), COUNT(*) FROM alarm_ctx WHERE errorcode IN ('81201','81203','81204')
)
SELECT c.cat AS "Alarm Category",
       c.alarm_pct AS "Alarm-Window %",
       CASE c.cat WHEN 'THERMAL (81501)' THEN b.temp_pct WHEN 'VACUUM (81101/02)' THEN b.vac_pct ELSE b.pe_pct END AS "Baseline %",
       ROUND((c.alarm_pct / NULLIF(CASE c.cat WHEN 'THERMAL (81501)' THEN b.temp_pct WHEN 'VACUUM (81101/02)' THEN b.vac_pct ELSE b.pe_pct END, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "Lift",
       c.n AS "Event Count",
       CASE WHEN c.n < 30 THEN 'LOW SAMPLE (n<30)' ELSE 'OK' END AS "Confidence"
FROM cats c CROSS JOIN baseline b
ORDER BY "Lift" DESC NULLS LAST

panels.description: RCA Truth Test: Alarm-Window % (rate of out-of-spec readings within 5min before this alarm) vs Baseline % (out-of-spec rate across all data, alarm or not). Lift = Alarm-Window % / Baseline % — lift > 2 means the alarm genuinely correlates with the process anomaly; lift ≈ 1 means no real relationship (threshold or sensor likely miscalibrated); lift < 1 means the correlation runs backwards and needs investigation. Confidence flags categories with fewer than 30 alarm events, where Lift is not statistically meaningful yet.
